name: com.biomiv/bioai
title: Biomiv BioAI
description: Health research agent: diets engineered for a condition, cited research, live trials. No key.

tools.name: bioai_ask
tools.description: Ask BioAI, the Biomiv health research agent, about a health condition, symptom or goal (or about the Biomiv site). Returns its answer as text with the link for the person: what the research relates to the condition and the diet engineered for it. Free, no account needed. Research information, not medical advice.

question.description: a condition, symptom, goal or question, in plain words (e.g. "gallstones")

tools.name: get_engineered_diet
tools.description: The diet the BIOMIC-42 algorithm engineered for a condition: the body processes behind the condition, what is reported to work against each, the suggested combination with its 0-100 score, recipes and citations. Free, no account needed. Research information, not medical advice.

tools.name: get_research_cards
tools.description: Research cards for a condition: foods, micronutrients, plant compounds, drug compounds, genes and proteins, each with what it addresses, its evidence and its citations, plus repurposed drug candidates. Free, no account needed. Research information, not medical advice.

tools.name: get_clinical_trials
tools.description: Clinical trials for a condition, read live from the public trials registry: most recently updated first, with the registry's total. Free, no account needed. Research information, not medical advice.

tools.name: get_healthspan_meter
tools.description: The healthspan meter for a condition's diet: years of life associated with its foods and nutrients, worked out from published studies of each item and death from any cause, with the sentence each number came from. Free, no account needed. Research information, not medical advice.

tools.name: get_molecular_view
tools.description: The molecular view for a condition: one compound and one protein it acts on, with the three-dimensional structure on record (an experimental structure of the two together, or the protein's predicted model). Free, no account needed. Research information, not medical advice.

tools.name: get_research_news
tools.description: The latest breakthroughs in health, medicine, biology, biotech and pharma, read every 30 minutes from science newsrooms, peer-reviewed journals and drug regulators: each story with its field, what it reports (approval, trial result, a first, new finding), a 0-1 breakthrough score, the drugs, genes, proteins, foods, nutrients and conditions it names, and the connections between them that no curated database holds yet. Free, no account needed. Research information, not medical advice.

topic.description: a condition, drug, gene, food or nutrient; or a field (medicine, pharma, biotech, biology, public_health); or "latest"

tools.name: connect_the_dots
tools.description: Walk the Biomiv interaction network of genes, proteins, enzymes, biochemicals, plant compounds, drug compounds, pathways and conditions. One name: its known links (each with its relation and source), the enzymes before and after it in metabolism, and its hidden leads (records two known links away that no source links directly). Two names: the chains of known links between them. Free, no account needed. Research information, not medical advice.

terms.description: one name, or two names separated by " and " (e.g. "GCDH", or "L-lysine and GCDH")

tools.name: get_research_weather
tools.description: What new research is naming right now: the terms with the most recent sightings in the last 24 hours of papers, strongest first, out of about 269,000 foods, micronutrients, plant compounds, drug compounds, genes, proteins, enzymes, diseases, metabolites, biochemicals and gut microbes. Each has its sightings and when it was last seen. It measures attention, not proof that anything works. Free, no account needed. Research information, not medical advice.

kind.description: one kind of term (e.g. "genes", "gut microbes", "plant compounds"), or "all"
